chain.title: A Vein of Jasper
chain.desc: Jasper Ore seams run from deep stone all the way up into the hills. The gems cut into a full early tool and armor set, and snap into a Terramity Empty Ring as your first accessory.

chain.title: The Ore That Isn't
chain.desc: Mimic Ore is everywhere below sea level - break it for Mimictite, the strange mineral that lets plain iron come alive.

chain.title: Iron, But Livelier
chain.desc: Press Mimictite into a raw iron block to wake Livin' Iron - a self-willed metal with a full gear set a clear step above what jasper gave you.

chain.title: Drowned Metal
chain.desc: Aquillone Ore hides in the deep. Smelt it into Oceanic Debris - the sea-soaked scrap behind the mod's first netherite-level upgrade.

chain.title: Aquillone
chain.desc: Fuse Oceanic Debris with a Terramity Sapphire into Aquillone, the ocean alloy. It also plusses the Ocean Explorer's Ring for serious underwater mobility.

chain.title: Template of the Tides
chain.desc: Craft the Aquillone Smithing Template from Oceanic Debris, Daemonium and a sapphire block - copies duplicate cheaply once you own one.

chain.title: Netherite Learns to Swim
chain.desc: Run your netherite armor and tools through the smithing table with the template and Aquillone - the whole ladder upgrades piece by piece into the Aquillone set.

chain.title: Gem of Focus
chain.desc: Ring a diamond with amethyst shards to condense an Amethyst Gem - one half of the Arcanum formula.

chain.title: The Pink Half
chain.desc: Temper quartz with an Iridium Chunk into Rose Quartz. With the Amethyst Gem and gold it completes the Arcanum recipe.

chain.title: Arcanum
chain.desc: Alloy Amethyst Gem, Rose Quartz and gold into Arcanum - a magic-flavored gear set, and with a Prismatic Ring it becomes the Arcane Ring.

chain.title: Light in the Deepslate
chain.desc: Deepslate Luminix Ore only spawns in the lowest layers. Smelt the raw chunks into Luminix ingots, the glowing base of the Iceltek alloy.

chain.title: Cold Fusion
chain.desc: Combine Luminix with netherite scrap to make Iceltekalloy. It forges frost gear, the Reach Ring and Reach Bracelets - but the armor also wants fabric from a certain gnome.

chain.title: Shredding the Gilded Hat
chain.desc: Unravel Gob's Gilded Hat - the trophy from Terramity's first boss - into Gobs Fabric, the lining every Iceltek tool and armor piece is stitched with.

chain.title: Dressed for the Blizzard
chain.desc: Stitch Gobs Fabric over Iceltekalloy plating for the Iceltek set, a full armor and tool tier with an ability of its own on the armor keybind.

chain.title: Shattered Star
chain.desc: Split a nether star into pieces - and with a Prismatic Jewel, pieces reassemble into whole stars, so the Wither only has to die so many times.

chain.title: Witherite
chain.desc: Bond a Nether Star Piece to netherite scrap for Witherite Alloy, the boss-grade metal of the next smithing tier.

chain.title: The Wither's Blueprint
chain.desc: Craft the Witherite Smithing Template from a star piece, Witherite and Daemonium; like the tide template, one copy breeds more.

chain.title: Armor of the Three Skulls
chain.desc: Smith your netherite gear up into the Witherite set - a straight power step past Aquillone, paid for in nether stars.

chain.title: Crystallized Sleeplessness
chain.desc: Insomnia Crystals are the price of refusing your bed - claim them from the sleepless nights. They carry Somnic power no other material has.

chain.title: Insomniac
chain.desc: Forge Insomnia Crystals with Iridium and Black Matter into Insomniac ingots - the metal that upgrades Terramity's iridium armor itself.

chain.title: Pattern of the Wakeful
chain.desc: Shape a template from Insomnia Crystal, Iridium Chunks and a Spectral Soul. It converts iridium armor and netherite tools to the Insomniac tier at the smithing table.

chain.title: Never Sleep Again
chain.desc: Upgrade your Terramity Iridium Chestplate with Insomniac metal - the wakeful set that turns sleep deprivation into a fighting style.

chain.title: Mining the Anomaly
chain.desc: Rare Anomaly blocks glitch into the world at any height. Break them for World Errors, reality's corrupted leftovers - also a fine building block for cursed bases.

chain.title: Compiled from Errors
chain.desc: Forge World Errors with Black Matter and Iridium into Glitch Steel, and craft the Glitch Rider set - gear stitched together from broken code.

chain.title: Do Not Lick the Ingot
chain.desc: Refine Nuclear Remnants with an Antiprism and Profanum into Nucleate - the Gas suit set is your only defense against the Radiation its own weapons spread.

chain.title: Seraphim's Ring
chain.desc: Weave an Angel Feather, Reverium and iridescent shards around a Prismatic Ring - the holy endgame accessory of the addon.

chain.title: Fragile Domination
chain.desc: Bind Exodium Superalloy, Nyxium, Reverium and a Shadowflame relic into Fragile Domination - the capstone trinket that demands trophies from the entire Terramity endgame.

notes: Terramity addon (nearly every recipe pulls terramity: ingredients - daemonium, sapphire, iridium, black_matter, profanum, reverium, exodium) - gate this chain alongside/after the terramity chain (same pack, GayChaseyPacxk). No advancements or guidebook in the jar; order derived from recipe dependency depth against terramity's own tier ladder (daemonium/sapphire early -> iridium T2 -> black matter/profanum/antiprism -> reverium/nyxium/exodium endgame) plus worldgen: jasperore (y-40..200, count 3) and mimicore (count 24, deepslate) are the abundant starters, aquillone_ore smelts to oceanic_debris, deepslate_luminix_ore drops rawluminix, glitch_ore ('Anomaly', any height, count 1) drops worlderror. All 27 chain + 29 collection ids verified against the 225 item/block lang stems and recipe results. Aquillone/Witherite are netherite smithing upgrades; Insomniac uniquely upgrades terramity iridium armor (verified smithing base terramity:iridium_armor_*). insomniacrystal and nuclearremnant sources are code-side (MCreator mod; effects Somnic Crystal/Sleep Paralysis and Radiation hint at phantom-night and nuclear mechanics) - descs kept source-vague deliberately. Skipped as unobtainable/joke: impossible_ring, slatsyr_ckcatt_a, goo, debug/error deco duplicates, train_engine, accursed_soul_block (needs terramity:accursed_soul), bee/beeck joke blocks.
